name: Roo Code
reason: Product/service shut down in May 2026; not considered an exploitable current solution.

name: Windsurf (standalone product identity)
reason: The current Windsurf desktop experience has been renamed/evolved into Devin Desktop; avoid double counting. JetBrains support may remain under Windsurf branding.

name: Sourcegraph Cody Free / Pro
reason: Individual Free/Pro offerings are not treated as current choices; Cody Enterprise remains active and Amp covers newer agentic use cases.

name: Evaluation-only scaffolds / benchmark runners
reason: May contribute evidence but are not user-facing tools an engineer would choose for daily work.

name: Reqtify
reason: Important traceability platform/source in the company context, but no native AI product was identified in this inventory phase. It remains a target data/tool integration for AI solutions.

name: OpenFastTrace
reason: Traceability tool/output target, not itself an AI solution.

name: PlantUML / Mermaid / Draw.io
reason: Important diagram formats/tools, but not counted as AI solutions unless used through an AI-enabled product such as Eraser, Lucid AI, Miro AI or a general/coding assistant.

name: Continue
reason: Continue announced it joined Cursor in 2026. The open-source code remains available, but the product is no longer treated as a maintained independent current choice.

name: Flowise
reason: The official Flowise site currently states that Flowise is being sunset. Preserve historical relevance but do not treat it as a long-term new deployment candidate.
